name: Epignosis
description:
Epignosis is a leading Software company specializing in learning solutions. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, we build training software to help companies of all sizes deliver online training easier and at a reasonable price.

We are a growing, profitable tech company with offices in San Francisco, London, Athens, Nicosia and Heraklion. Our product portfolio includes TalentLMS, a popular cloud based LMS for companies of all sizes, eFront, a cutting-edge enterprise grade LMS, and TalentCards, a mobile microlearning solution. We strive to balance usability, simplicity and fit-to-purpose solutions, paired with robustness and strong potential. We believe that great companies are built on empathy, integrity, diversity & simplicity.


Find us here: https://www.epignosishq.com/

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
At Epignosis our mission is simple yet bold: To make learning technologies accessible to every business, regardless of geography, sector, or company size. And we’ve been doing just that for more than two decades, empowering millions of people to grow, learn, and thrive through technology that’s both powerful and affordable. 

We're rapidly becoming one of Greece's largest SaaS companies, serving 12,000+ companies and 11+ million learners worldwide with solutions like TalentLMS (an award-winning cloud LMS built for simplicity), eFront (an enterprise LMS), TalentCards (a mobile app for deskless training), and TalentHR (a lightweight HRIS for people operations). 

Our success is built on a team that believes that work should matter — not only to you, but to the world around you. We're looking for people who light up when solving hard problems, who care deeply about their craft, and who want to build something that genuinely helps people grow.

We are searching for a skilled Data Engineer to join our Data Team and play a key role in implementing our Data Transformation project. The ideal candidate will design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and workflows to support analytics and business intelligence initiatives. Additionally, they will be responsible for managing data infrastructure, optimizing databases and schemas, and ensuring data integrity.

This role involves close collaboration with Developers, DevOps, AI Engineers and other cross-functional teams to optimize queries and databases, propose scalable architecture solutions, and identify data requirements that drive our services forward.

Responsibilities

As a Data Engineer, you will:

  • Monitor and optimize database performance, implementing tuning measures while ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Provide proactive and reactive data management support, including user training and troubleshooting.
  • Work closely with developers to optimize queries and design efficient database schemas.
  • Collaborate with AI Team to support AI-driven initiatives.
  • Design, develop, and maintain ETL pipelines to efficiently process and integrate data from multiple sources.
  • Partner with different team within the Engineering department to understand data needs and deliver data solutions.
  • Implement data modeling techniques to create efficient schemas for relational and non-relational databases, such as Aurora, DynamoDB or other.
  • Optimize data workflows and storage solutions to enhance performance and scalability.
  • Ensure data quality and consistency through validation and cleaning processes.

Requirements

To be successful in this role as a Data Engineer, you should have:

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or similar roles.
  • Proficiency in Python and experience with Apache Spark for large-scale data processing.
  • Proficiency in SQL and hands-on experience with database management systems.
  • Experience with cloud technologies, particularly AWS (e.g., S3, Glue, Lambda).
  • Strong understanding of databases, data lakes, and data warehousing principles.
  • Experience with NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB).
  • Strong data modeling skills to support analytical and reporting needs.
  • Experience in designing and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Familiarity with data warehousing solutions and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, QuickSight).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Multi-constrained optimization considering performance, cost, value, complexity, ease of maintenance and tradeoffs thereof.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.


Bonus points

  • Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Kafka).
  • Familiarity with AWS Athena and Redshift will be a plus. 

Benefits

We've built a workplace where people can do the best work of their careers. Here's how we support that:

  • Competitive salary and bonuses. Strong base pay plus performance rewards at personal, team, and company levels.
  • Stock options for everyone. Build software that empowers millions of learners worldwide, and own a piece of what you're creating. All team members can become shareholders, and these options have already changed lives.
  • Your health is covered in more ways than one. Private health coverage for every team member, access to a nutritionist, and our in-house blood bank — all part of our health and wellness support.
  • Comprehensive family support. We’re proud of our progressive family policy, one of the most generous in Greece.
  • Daily meals and food allowance. Breakfast and catered lunch at our offices, plus a monthly meal allowance you control.
  • Commute covered. OASA transport card or parking space near the office, whichever works for your commute.
  • Hybrid work. Work from home and from our modern office in the heart of Athens.
  • Learning budget for your growth. Coaching sessions, conferences, university degrees, creative pursuits — we fund it. Continuous learning is our mission and that includes you.
  • Part of the Starttech Ventures ecosystem. Access to learning and collaboration across a portfolio of SaaS companies, with resources that support long-term growth.

Ready to grow your career while helping millions of people learn? Join us.

We're looking for exceptional junior and mid-level Software Engineers who think beyond the code, care about the products they build, and love turning ideas into polished experiences. Your work will span everything from early prototypes to products used by tens of thousands of organizations and millions of people worldwide — directly shaping how they learn, work, and grow.

As a Generalist, Product-minded Software Engineer you will:

  • Own product development end-to-end—from understanding the problem and shaping the solution to building, launching, and iterating.
  • Understand and analyze user and stakeholder feedback, translating it into practical product improvements.
  • Turn ambiguous ideas into clear priorities, focused scopes, and working prototypes.
  • Shape exceptional UI and user experiences across the product, with attention to clarity, consistency, and craft.
  • Build across the stack, taking on frontend, backend, integrations, and infrastructure as needed.
  • Make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, quality, and scope to deliver value quickly.
  • Collaborate closely with design, product, and business teams, contributing to both what we build and how we build it.
  • Ship reliable, intuitive experiences and own testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Measure how products perform, learn from real usage, and take responsibility for outcomes.

Requirements

To be successful in this role you should:

  • Be a builder. Turn ideas into working software—and have projects to show for it.
  • Have a feel for great software and excellent UI/UX. Notice the details that make products intuitive and enjoyable to use.
  • Think in terms of products. Understand the user’s problem, question assumptions, and help decide what’s worth building.
  • Be an exceptional engineer for your experience level.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience across multiple technologies and programming paradigms.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous programming.
  • Open-source contributions you can point us to.



Get your application noticed by including the following:

  1. The things you’ve built. A GitHub profile, a portfolio, or a few good development war stories. Tell us what you built, what you owned, and what you learned. University assignments carry less weight unless they’re complete projects you conceived and built independently.
  2. Your take on good and bad UX. Pick one product that gets it right and one that frustrates you. For bonus points: tell us why and what you’d change.

We're searching for a Partner Marketing Lead to help establish partner marketing as a function at Epignosis, covering our full product portfolio. This is our first dedicated partner marketing hire, sitting within the Product Marketing team and reporting to the Product Marketing Lead. You'll work hand-in-hand with the VP of Partnerships and the wider partnerships team as their go-to marketer across the partner ecosystem.  If you enjoy building programs from scratch, turning product stories into partner-ready assets, and driving co-marketing that moves revenue, we would love to meet you.

Responsibilities

As the Partner Marketing Lead, you will shape how Epignosis shows up to its partner ecosystem across TalentLMS, eFront, TalentCards, and TalentHR, and the story that connects them as a suite.

Set the partner marketing strategy: Translate company GTM priorities into partner-facing plans across the full partner lifecycle (recruitment, onboarding, activation, and growth), differentiated by partner tier and type.

Build and evolve the partner enablement toolkit: Decide what partners need to sell effectively and produce it: co-brandable company deck, product decks, competitor battlecards, objection handling guides, proposal templates, and roadmap summaries. Set the bar for content quality and freshness across all partner-facing materials.

Position our products for the partner channel: Adapt product messaging, positioning, and proof points for partner audiences and their end-customers, so partners can pitch Epignosis with the same clarity and confidence as our direct sales team.

Drive partner communications and campaigns: Own partner newsletters, product release notes, and program updates. Plan and run a partner webinar cadence covering roadmap updates, product awareness, and GTM best practices.

Lead partner event marketing: Decide how partners show up alongside Epignosis at industry events, and equip them for it with co-branded collateral, messaging guidance, and joint-presence logistics. Turn MDF-funded event lead-gen reports into recommendations that sharpen future co-marketing investment.

Own partner brand and web presence: Own the partner landing page on the Epignosis website, shape the partner directory build, and set the partner brand guidelines and tier badges that define how partners represent Epignosis.

Turn partner success into growth assets: Identify the partner stories worth telling and produce case studies, testimonials, and joint success stories in collaboration with the product marketing team and the partnerships team.

Measure what matters and act on it: Track marketing asset usage, partner communications metrics, and campaign performance. Turn partner feedback and performance signals into a content roadmap that keeps getting sharper.

Requirements

To be successful in this role, you should have:

  • 3–5 years of B2B marketing experience, with a background in SaaS, EdTech, or channel/partner marketing.
  • A builder's mindset. You've stood up a function or a program before, or operated inside one small enough that you had to. You're comfortable with ambiguity and being the first person in the seat.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to run multiple end-to-end programs and campaigns simultaneously (webinars, email, content, and co-marketing) from idea to delivery with minimal oversight.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can create assets, write content, and turn complex product stories into clear, compelling language.
  • A genuine self-starter. You take initiative, own your work from idea to delivery, and set your own pace against quarterly goals. You’re equally comfortable working independently and collaborating closely with senior stakeholders across marketing, partnerships, product, and sales.
  • A learning mindset. You'll need to become fluent in four products and a suite story quickly. That takes curiosity and effort.

Benefits

We've built a workplace where people can do the best work of their careers. Here's how we support that:

  • Competitive salary and bonuses. Strong base pay plus performance rewards at personal, team, and company levels.
  • Stock options for everyone. Build software that empowers millions of learners worldwide, and own a piece of what you're creating. All team members can become shareholders, and these options have already changed lives.
  • Your health is covered in more ways than one. Private health coverage for every team member, access to a nutritionist, and our in-house blood bank — all part of our health and wellness support.
  • Comprehensive family support. We’re proud of our progressive family policy, one of the most generous in Greece.
  • Daily meals and food allowance. Breakfast and catered lunch at our offices, plus a monthly meal allowance you control.
  • Commute covered. OASA transport card or parking space near the office, whichever works for your commute.
  • Hybrid work. Work from home and from our modern office in the heart of Athens.
  • Learning budget for your growth. Coaching sessions, conferences, university degrees, creative pursuits — we fund it. Continuous learning is our mission and that includes you.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (Future Opportunities)
jobs.description:

We are searching for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead one of our product engineering organisations. This is a role for someone who has done the job before and wants a bigger version of it: several teams, real ownership of a product line, and a leadership group that needs growing. You will be accountable for how engineering delivers on that product - the teams, the people in them, and the quality of what reaches our customers.

We are also at an interesting moment. We are moving from four products that grew up separately toward a connected suite, which means the way our teams are organised is genuinely changing. You will help shape that, not just operate inside it.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will:

  • Stay close to the work. You won't be on the critical path for production code, but you will read code, join incidents, prototype when it helps you understand a problem, and use the tools your teams use.
  • Own engineering delivery for a product line, working in close partnership with its Product counterpart.
  • Lead several teams through their tech leads and managers, rather than directly managing every engineer yourself.
  • Grow tech leads into engineering managers - coaching, feedback, and the difficult conversations that come with it.
  • Set and hold delivery expectations, and be honest with the business about what is and isn't achievable.
  • Own team health: hiring, onboarding, performance, and the day-to-day conditions that let engineers do good work.
  • Make clear ownership decisions - which team owns which system, and what happens when work crosses boundaries.
  • Balance feature delivery against platform health, and make the trade-offs explicit rather than implicit.
  • Work with peers across the engineering organisation on shared services, standards, and the suite architecture that connects our products.

Requirements

To be successful in this role as a Senior Engineering Manager, you should have:

  • 5+ years managing software engineers, including experience managing or coaching other leads or managers.
  • The technical depth to engage with architecture decisions on their merits - you can weigh a trade-off, challenge an estimate, and tell when a delivery problem is really a design problem.
  • Experience leading more than one team at a time, in a product organisation rather than an agency or project setting.
  • A track record of growing individuals - people who are better engineers or leaders because they worked for you.
  • Comfort with organisational ambiguity, and the judgement to know when to bring structure and when to leave space.
  • Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to explain engineering realities to non-engineers without either oversimplifying or hiding behind detail.
  • Availability to work in a hybrid setup with 2-3 days per week in our Athens / Heraklion office.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with team topology models and a considered view on how teams should be shaped around systems.
  • Experience in SaaS at scale, with multi-tenant products and the operational realities that come with them.
  • Experience through an organisational change - a restructure, a merge of teams, or a shift from product silos to shared platforms.
  • Familiarity with SQL, PHP, Python or JavaScript-based stacks and AWS.

We are looking for an experienced  Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our Quality Platform team at Epignosis, working on TalentLMS. In this role, you'll help build, maintain, and evolve our automation framework — the backbone of test automation across our product teams. You'll design and execute automated test scenarios, collaborate closely with QA chapter peers and engineering teams to prioritize and troubleshoot issues, and contribute hands-on to raising the bar on quality across the organization. Manual and exploratory testing will also be part of your remit when necessary.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer, you will:

  • Partner with our development teams — spanning product teams, the AI team, architecture, and the frontend chapter — to define test scope and align automation coverage with each team's priorities and release goals.
  • Collaborate with QA chapter members to maintain consistency, reusability, and quality standards across the shared automation framework — including shared step definitions, naming conventions, and scenario design patterns.
  • Work with team and chapter leads to prioritize automation work based on risk, release timelines, and coverage gaps — balancing competing requests across teams.
  • Actively contribute to the evolution of our shared Cypress tool — improving reliability, execution speed, and maintainability, and helping extend its capabilities (e.g., API test coverage, reusable step libraries, AI-assisted test designs and operations) as team needs grow.
  • Design and develop well-structured test scripts for assigned features, ensuring the scripts are readable, maintainable, and reusable across the shared framework — then execute and monitor them as part of CI/CD pipelines.
  • Analyze test failures to distinguish genuine defects from flaky tests or environment issues, and collaborate with developers to diagnose root causes and drive fixes.
  • Perform manual and exploratory testing when necessary.
  • Constantly educate yourself! We encourage and promote training, upskilling, and staying current with emerging practices like AI-augmented testing.

Requirements

To be successful in this role as a Senior QA Automation Engineer, you should have:

  • 5+ years of professional experience working with web and API test automation.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as JavaScript (preferably), Python, PHP, or Java.
  • Solid grounding in QA methodologies and test design techniques with the ability to apply them pragmatically.
  • Solid hands-on experience with test automation tools and frameworks, such as Cypress (preferably), Playwright, Cucumber, etc.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities — able to diagnose root causes of failures efficiently and maintain attention to detail across large, shared test suites.
  • Familiarity with shift-left testing and agile testing practices, with a genuine interest in AI-augmented testing approaches (e.g., AI-assisted test generation, self-healing tests, or intelligent test maintenance).
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Nice to have

  • BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience with using Postman/Swagger.
  • Experience with virtualization or containerization technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, AWS ECS, and CI/CD tools like GitHub actions.
  • ISTQB foundation/advanced level certification.

We've built a workplace where people can do the best work of their careers. Here's how we support that:

  • Competitive salary and bonuses. Strong base pay plus performance rewards at personal, team, and company levels.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Epignosis our mission is simple yet bold: To make learning technologies accessible to every business, regardless of geography, sector, or company size. And we've been doing just that for more than two decades, empowering millions of people to grow, learn, and thrive through technology that's both powerful and affordable.

We're rapidly becoming one of Greece's largest SaaS companies, serving 12,000+ companies and 22+ million learners worldwide with solutions like TalentLMS (an award-winning cloud LMS built for simplicity), eFront (an enterprise LMS), TalentCards (a mobile app for deskless training), and TalentHR (a lightweight HRIS for people operations).

Our success is built on a team that believes that work should matter — not only to you, but to the world around you. We're looking for people who light up when solving hard problems, who care deeply about their craft, and who want to build something that genuinely helps people grow.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to take ownership of the most complex and ambiguous engineering challenges within their team. You’ll take substantial projects from an unclear problem through to production and beyond, identify architectural and delivery risks before they become issues, and raise the bar for code quality, testing, and reliability across the systems your team owns. You’ll also play an important role in helping the engineers around you grow through code reviews, pairing, knowledge sharing, and technical direction.

The role is scoped to a single team. You’ll collaborate across team boundaries when the work calls for it, while driving multi-team architecture or engineering standards sits at the level above.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:

  • Lead complex work end to end. Take substantial features and services from design through delivery and production follow-up. You're accountable for how they behave in production, not just for merged pull requests.
  • Turn ambiguity into a plan. Turn unclear problem statements into a technical approach, a delivery plan, and explicit trade-offs. Work with Product Managers on PRD analysis, story breakdown, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
  • Make and record design decisions. Own design decisions within your team's domain: data model, API surface, background processing, failure modes, caching, and concurrency. Write down significant decisions before building, including the alternatives you rejected and the consequences you accepted.
  • Spot risk early. Surface architectural, security, reliability, and delivery risks, such as unclear requirements, cross-team dependencies, and scale cliffs. Bring viable alternatives, and escalate decisions that sit beyond your authority.
  • Build security in. Design and implement security controls that fit the system and its trust boundaries. Be deliberate about who and what can reach each surface, how data is protected, and how dependencies and secrets are managed. Think about threats during design, not after.
  • Raise engineering health. Strengthen tests, observability, design boundaries, and reliability controls for team-owned systems. Propose refactoring, performance, and simplification work with a clear payoff, even when nobody asked for it.
  • Take on the hardest problems. Troubleshoot the team's toughest technical and production issues. Lead incident response for team-owned systems, and drive postmortem actions to closure so the same root cause doesn't come back.
  • Review in a way that teaches. Give technical direction through code and design review. Explain your reasoning, link references, flag missing tests, and separate fact from preference.
  • Grow the people around you. Mentor less experienced engineers through pairing and guidance so they can take on harder work themselves, without you becoming the bottleneck.
  • Stay connected to the why. Understand what each feature changes for the customer, and push back when the technical solution and the business goal drift apart.

What success looks like in your first year:

  • You've led complex, ambiguous work from problem definition to production, and it met its delivery, reliability, and adoption goals.
  • Significant decisions in your area are written down and reviewed before the code is written.
  • The systems your team owns are measurably healthier than when you arrived: tests, observability, and reliability have all improved.
  • Incidents in your area are resolved, root-caused, and don't recur.
  • Engineers you've mentored are taking on harder work and applying your guidance without needing you in the room.

Requirements

To be successful as a Senior Software Engineer you should:

  • 5+ years building and running production web applications and distributed systems at scale.
  • A track record of owning complex work end to end. You've taken ambiguous problems to production and lived with the results.
  • A solid understanding of multi-tenant architectures (tenant isolation, data partitioning, noisy-neighbour protection), ideally from having built or run a multi-tenant SaaS product yourself.
  • Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and systems thinking.
  • Deep relational database skills: schema design, query optimisation, indexing, and data consistency.
  • Hands-on experience with modern API design, automated testing, CI/CD, and production observability (logs, metrics, traces).
  • A pragmatic, language-agnostic mindset. Our primary backend is modern PHP today. Fluency helps, but we hire for engineering capability and judgment over single-language dogma.
  • Curiosity. You want to understand how things work, and you keep learning about the system, the customer, and the craft.
  • A collaborative, direct, and kind communication style, and comfort explaining trade-offs to engineers and non-engineers alike.

Benefits

We've built a workplace where people can do the best work of their careers. Here's how we support that:

  • Competitive salary and bonuses. Strong base pay plus performance rewards at personal, team, and company levels.
  • Stock options for everyone. Build software that empowers millions of learners worldwide, and own a piece of what you're creating. All team members can become shareholders, and these options have already changed lives.
  • Your health is covered in more ways than one. Private health coverage for every team member, access to a nutritionist, and our in-house blood bank — all part of our health and wellness support.
  • Comprehensive family support. We’re proud of our progressive family policy, one of the most generous in Greece.
  • Daily meals and food allowance. Breakfast and catered lunch at our offices, plus a monthly meal allowance you control.
  • Commute covered. OASA transport card or parking space near the office, whichever works for your commute.
  • Hybrid work. Work from home and from our modern office in the heart of Athens.
  • Learning budget for your growth. Coaching sessions, conferences, university degrees, creative pursuits — we fund it. Continuous learning is our mission and that includes you.
  • Part of the Starttech Ventures ecosystem. Access to learning and collaboration across a portfolio of SaaS companies, with resources that support long-term growth.

Ready to grow your career while helping millions of people learn? Join us.
